import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/root/protein_expression.xlsx', data_only=True)
ds = wb['Data']
ts = wb['Task']

# Compare sample names: Data D-M (cols 4-13) vs Task C-L (cols 3-12)
print('=== SAMPLE NAME COMPARISON ===')
all_match = True
for i in range(10):
    data_col = 4 + i
    task_col = 3 + i
    data_val = ds.cell(row=1, column=data_col).value
    task_val = ts.cell(row=10, column=task_col).value
    match = data_val == task_val
    if not match:
        all_match = False
    data_letter = openpyxl.utils.get_column_letter(data_col)
    task_letter = openpyxl.utils.get_column_letter(task_col)
    print(f'  Data {data_letter}1 = {repr(data_val)}')
    print(f'  Task {task_letter}10 = {repr(task_val)}')
    print(f'  Match: {match}')
    print()
print(f'ALL SAMPLE NAMES MATCH: {all_match}')

print()

# Compare Protein_IDs: Data A2-A11 vs Task A11-A20
print('=== PROTEIN_ID COMPARISON ===')
all_match2 = True
for i in range(10):
    data_row = 2 + i
    task_row = 11 + i
    data_val = ds.cell(row=data_row, column=1).value
    task_val = ts.cell(row=task_row, column=1).value
    match = data_val == task_val
    if not match:
        all_match2 = False
    print(f'  Data A{data_row} = {repr(data_val)}')
    print(f'  Task A{task_row} = {repr(task_val)}')
    print(f'  Match: {match}')
    print()
print(f'ALL PROTEIN_IDS MATCH: {all_match2}')
"
